findings.summary: PR reads as AI-generated; org AI policy closes such PRs on sight
os.PathLike serialized with str() instead of os.fspath(); wrong for DirEntry or __fspath__-only classes
Feature (new JSON type) and bug fix (dataclass guard) mixed in one PR, targeting different branches
Dataclass-class guard changes only the TypeError message (and makes it worse); not a bug worth catching, drop it
Guard leaves an unused type: ignore that likely fails the mypy typing job
PR template skipped: no ticket, no docs or versionchanged
PR body claims are false or unsupported (stdlib behavior, tested types, all tests pass)
Imports inside test functions instead of at top of file

why: Finding 1 names the AI-policy closure, part of the maintainer's stated reason, and finding 4 separately says the changed error message is not worth a fix; the reviewer never objects to adding PathLike as a type on principle, so the match rests mainly on the AI policy and the error-message point.
